data.action: 双手怀抱金边圣典微侧头微笑，彩窗光辉洒落
data.animaCaption: Standing beneath towering stained-glass windows inside a sunlit cathedral, she holds a gold-trimmed prayer book against her chest and smiles warmly in her wide-brimmed liturgical hat.
data.camera: 中景，微仰视，高耸哥特立柱与花窗背景
data.description: 清晨的拉古那圣咏大教堂内，五彩斑斓的玫瑰花窗洒下金色光束，菲比身着白金圣咏礼装，双手合十捧着金色祈祷书温柔微笑。
data.lighting: 彩绘花窗投射的七彩晨光光束
data.location: 拉古那圣咏大教堂玫瑰花窗下
data.promptProse: Bathed in jewel-toned morning light streaming through cathedral stained glass, Phoebe cradles a gilt-edged scripture book in her white-and-gold ceremonial vestments, offering a serene smile.
data.title: 菲比 · 圣咏大教堂彩绘玻璃晨祷
